seed_order: Every matching seed_range expands to consecutive actual seed values. Each unit repeats identical requests in warmup and each of four paired rounds; no Linux permutation is applied. CLI repeats [0,count).
summation: Group by case, workers, variant and global_sample; sum tested and seconds over all components and request_index. Cheap w8 has3 requests/jobs per complete sample; cheap w12 has6 requests across3jobs. These are not extra independent repetitions.

mutation_whitelist: measurement-design text: candidate source plus selected units
selection_proof.measurement_scope: Four paired rounds AB, BA, AB, BA plus one A/B warmup per component; eight timed variant executions, not four complete ABBA blocks. Full JSONL outputs retained; CLI equality is count-only.
selection_proof.component_limit: Cheap w8/w12 sum three fixed components per sample. w12 components contain two requests. Preserve individual request times and aggregate same global sample index; components are not independent repeats and are not continuous long requests.
selection_proof.environment_limit: Counts differ across workers, so comparisons are not fixed-N strong scaling. Planned seconds are historical C17-rate projections, not a speedup claim. Builds/output/waits add wall time.
selection_proof.submission_status: Prepared only. Owner must confirm provisioning, correctness, and queue state before submission. Local validation is schema-only.
